picks.question: Will inflation reach more than 4.5% in 2026?
picks.why: Inflation above 4.5% would signal renewed price pressure, constraining Federal Reserve rate decisions and eroding real wages and bond returns.

picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: About a fifth of global oil passes through Hormuz, so prolonged disruption keeps energy prices, shipping costs and inflation risks elevated.

picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A state-level wealth tax would test whether taxing billionaires' wealth can raise revenue without prompting capital flight or residency changes.

picks.question: Will Anthropic have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Leadership in frontier AI shapes where investment, talent and productivity gains concentrate across a rapidly consolidating industry.

picks.question: Will an AI lab announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2026?
picks.why: AI solving a famous unsolved math problem would mark a leap in machine reasoning, with implications for research productivity and growth.

picks.question: Will OpenAI’s market cap be $1.5T or greater at market close on IPO day by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: An OpenAI IPO valued above $1.5 trillion would show how much capital public markets will commit to AI's future earnings.
